scope: External products, collections, marketplaces and pipeline companions; no installation testing or exhaustive-web claim.

additions.creator: Akascape
additions.name: BlockGlitch
additions.description: Block-glitch Fuse for Resolve 17+ Free or Studio. The creator explicitly offers a free download; the amount field can show a suggested donation.

additions.creator: Akascape
additions.name: SuperGlitch
additions.description: Glitch-effect Fuse for Resolve 17+ Free or Studio. The creator explicitly offers a free download; check the selected amount at checkout.

additions.creator: Akascape
additions.name: SuperModulation
additions.description: Frequency-modulation Fuse. V1 is free; V2+ adds controls including colored modulation and direction. Supports Resolve Free and Studio.

additions.creator: Akascape
additions.name: SuperPixelSort
additions.description: Pixel-sorting Fuse with displacement and rank modes. Free edition has fewer features; Resolve 17+ Free or Studio.

additions.creator: Akascape
additions.name: SuperPolygons
additions.description: Low-poly, triangulation, Voronoi, and tile effects inside Fusion. Resolve 17+ Free or Studio; suggested donations are optional.

additions.creator: Akascape
additions.name: SuperSlitScanner
additions.description: Slit-scan Fuse with wave, stretch, time-warp, and modulation modes. Resolve 17+ Free or Studio.

additions.creator: Akascape
additions.name: SuperTrails
additions.description: Ghost-trail mode is free; the full edition adds trail modes. Resolve 17+ Free or Studio.

additions.creator: Akascape
additions.name: SuperVHS
additions.description: VHS-style bloom, distortion, and color damage inside Fusion. Resolve 17+ Free or Studio. Previously unresolved wiki lead, now supported by its indexed creator listing.

additions.creator: Akascape
additions.name: SupaScale
additions.description: AI upscaling/restoration Fuse with multiple models. Resolve 19+ Free or Studio. Trial includes a limited model; test compatibility before purchase.

additions.creator: Akascape
additions.name: BlobTrackingFuse
additions.description: Motion-responsive lines, rectangles, and text effects. Resolve 17+ Free or Studio. Creator warns that AMD devices may not work properly.

additions.creator: StirlingSupplyCo.
additions.name: Easier Ease
additions.description: Applies easing to position, scale, and rotation keyframes. Requires Resolve 19.1+. A separate paid Pro edition exists.

additions.creator: StirlingSupplyCo.
additions.name: Edit Page Masks
additions.description: Drag-and-drop Edit-page masks with outline and shape controls. Current listing does not establish a minimum version or OS matrix.

additions.creator: StirlingSupplyCo.
additions.name: Proto V3
additions.description: Distortion and glow effects with presets. Current release requires Resolve 20.

additions.creator: StirlingSupplyCo.
additions.name: TextBox+
additions.description: Animated text-box preset for Resolve. Consult current installation requirements; no OS matrix was established.

additions.creator: MotionVFX
additions.name: mTransition Movie DVR
additions.description: Cinema-inspired transition pack. Desktop requires Resolve 18.1.2+; vendor also labels the DVR edition iPad-compatible. Select the DVR product.

additions.creator: MotionVFX
additions.name: mTitle Refined DVR
additions.description: Animated typography pack. Desktop requires Resolve 19.1, 16 GB RAM and 4 GB VRAM; vendor recommends 32/8 GB for 4K and lists iPad compatibility.

additions.creator: Gabriel Grenier
additions.name: Amalgam
additions.description: Frequency-based image blending OFX; compatibility lists Resolve 16–21. Mac support is evidenced by the release notes. The separate Premiere transition feature is not a Resolve guarantee.

additions.creator: imk-design
additions.name: AE Fusion 3D Bridge
additions.description: Transfers supported 3D layouts, cameras, and baked animation between After Effects and Fusion/Resolve. Does not embed media or reproduce the entire rendered appearance.

additions.creator: Limitless Creative
additions.name: Blender to Resolve Bridge
additions.description: Blender render handoff with bins, timeline settings, and color transforms. Windows 10/11, Blender 4.2+, Resolve 19. Studio auto-push needs Python 3.11/3.12; Free uses a browser workflow.

additions.creator: BelAmiMax
additions.name: BlenderEXR
additions.description: Installs Blender OCIO configuration and a Fusion EXR/pass template. Windows 10/11 or Apple Silicon Mac; Resolve 19–21. Intel Mac support is not established.

additions.creator: CStudio.ao
additions.name: Pipeline Studio Manager
additions.description: Blender production-management add-on with structured Resolve handoff packages. A pipeline companion, not an in-Resolve plugin. Listing specifies Blender 4.0–5.2; live collaboration is beta.

additions.creator: ValueFactory
additions.name: VideoRemap
additions.description: Remaps footage from Resolume Advanced Output XML inside Resolve Free or Studio. Windows 10+ x86_64 and NVIDIA CUDA required; ARM unsupported. Resolume need not be installed.

additions.creator: Jumper
additions.name: Jumper
additions.description: Local visual and spoken-content search for editors, with Resolve integration. Vendor states processing stays on device. Confirm current host/version requirements for the chosen installer.

additions.creator: sh4rk
additions.name: Audio Visualiser Plugin
additions.description: Audio-reactive Fusion toolkit and Edit-page visualizers. Supports Resolve 19.1–21 Free and Studio. Uses the supplied audio-converter workflow; current creator site supersedes the Ko-fi listing.

additions.creator: Mixkit
additions.name: Mixkit Resolve templates
additions.access: 🆓 Free under Mixkit License; no signup
additions.description: Titles, callouts, lower thirds, transitions, and social templates. FAQ says designed for Resolve 16; newer-version compatibility needs checking per template.

additions.creator: Motion Array
additions.name: Motion Array free Resolve templates
additions.access: 🆓 Free selection; broader catalogue has paid plans
additions.description: Resolve-filtered titles, logos, promos, and other templates. Use the software-version filter and inspect each item’s requirements and download/license conditions.

additions.creator: Envato
additions.name: Envato Resolve templates
additions.description: Resolve-specific template marketplace. Check item-level version, plugin, font, and media requirements; preview footage/music may be excluded.

additions.creator: Editors Lab
additions.name: Editors Lab
additions.description: Community discovery hub for Resolve macros, Fuses, presets, and tutorials. Follow original creator listings for licenses and compatibility; its entries overlap other resources here.

additions.creator: Tool&KITS
additions.name: Sony S-Log3 Cine Film Emulation PowerGrade
additions.description: Node-based film-inspired starting point for Sony S-Log3 / S-Gamut3.Cine. Built for Resolve Free with its included film LUTs; not an exact film-stock reproduction.

additions.creator: Night Owl Stories
additions.name: C.R.A.F.T. PowerGrade
additions.description: Kodak/Fuji PowerGrade variants with a setup guide. Preconfigured for Sony S-Log3; input CST can be changed. Free/Studio compatible; texture is a placeholder.

additions.creator: yesjmo
additions.name: PowerGrade Library
additions.description: Modular grading library, signature looks, and guides. Resolve 19+ Free or Studio; designed for DaVinci Wide Gamut with Rec.709 output.

additions.creator: open iso
additions.name: Cine16
additions.description: 16 mm-inspired color PowerGrade with tutorial and test clips. All features require Resolve Studio.

additions.creator: open iso
additions.name: Timeless
additions.description: Black-and-white PowerGrade with tutorial and test clips. All features require Resolve Studio. Distinct from similarly named products by other creators.

additions.creator: The Jake Fisher
additions.name: TJF PowerGrade
additions.description: Modular film-inspired grade with tutorial. Free Resolve is supported with noise reduction and grain disabled; Studio enables those features.

additions.creator: Mark Bone + Nik Pilecki
additions.name: MB+NP PowerGrade
additions.description: Resolve PowerGrade, LUT suite, and grading masterclass with multiple camera color-space workflows. Current listing does not establish Free/Studio or OS requirements.

additions.creator: James Miller / DELUTS
additions.name: DELUTS Universe DCTLs
additions.description: Studio DCTL collection for color, lens effects, film texture, and utilities. Installation paths cover three OSes; test the demo for GPU compatibility. The listed minimum-version text is ambiguous.

additions.creator: Dehancer
additions.name: Dehancer Pro
additions.description: Film-emulation OFX with grain, halation, bloom, and color-pipeline controls. Current page lists all three OSes; displayed Mac requirements are macOS 13+, Metal GPU, Resolve 19+.

additions.creator: Colourlab.ai
additions.name: Colourlab AI for Resolve
additions.description: Reference matching through a Resolve plugin and desktop app. Official page specifies Resolve 18–20, including Free. Pro adds LookDesigner and GrainLab; newer-host support needs confirmation.

additions.creator: Nx Color
additions.name: Nx LiquidGlass
additions.description: Refraction and magnification DCTL. Requires Resolve Studio 19+; creator lists Metal, CUDA, and OpenCL support. Ko-fi listing points to the creator’s website download.

additions.creator: Ravengrade
additions.name: Ravengrade tools
additions.description: Collection of Resolve film-look, contrast, subtractive-color tools, and LUTs. Check each product’s Studio, GPU, and version requirements; collection membership does not establish shared compatibility.
